6. On an unused failed/partial operation run --mode rollback against the SAME operation. It drops only operation-attributed accounts and the exact owned procedure, then conditionally restores original runtime and persisted global state and reads back all original accounts/grants. Foreign objects, actual enrollment/config or identity drift are refusals. Private operation and rollback records remain retained.

7. Run wrapper action enroll: it FIRST invokes native query and requires desired_actual_accounts_verified (original-state/no-change query cannot qualify). It reads native-produced sql-accounts-materials.public.json, verifies exact installer/business DSN pins, and passes the actual native-selected username plus existing private password path into the genuine original-enroll producer. That producer shares the native SQL account scope lock for its whole real enrollment path, closing account-rollback vs original-enrollment races.
